cms_entries.title: You Don't Need a Dev Team to Ship SaaS — Here's Proof
cms_entries.description:
Three production SaaS products, built and shipped by one developer. This is a 60-second look at what came out of it.

What's in the video:

▸ Multi-tenant POS & ERP — offline-first, syncs when the connection returns. Per-company module control from a single super-admin panel, so each business only sees what it pays for.

▸ Attendance & payroll dashboard — upload one CSV, map the columns once, and 32 employees across 4 different pay models (monthly, daily, hourly, quantity-based) calculate in a single click. Exports to CSV and PDF.

▸ Bilingual matching platform — full English/Bangla interface, auth, payments, verification badges and privacy controls built into the data model rather than bolted on afterwards.

The stack:
Next.js (App Router) · React · Prisma · PostgreSQL · Tailwind · deployed on Vercel

How it was built:
AI-assisted development with Claude Code — scoped, generated, then reviewed line by line. The AI writes faster than I do. It does not decide the schema, the tenancy model, or what happens when the network drops. That part is still the job.

Every client build ships with full source code. No locked platform, no monthly hostage fee.
